data.title: Green Vein
data.about:
Luxury living reaches new heights at Damac Green Vein by Damac Properties, the latest development nestled within the prestigious Damac Riverside community, featuring 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses. This exclusive residential enclave offers an unparalleled fusion of opulence, tranquility, and wellness. With lush green surroundings and open parks, the facades set a new standard for refined living in the heart of Dubai.

Green Vein strategic location within the Damac Riverside community allows residents to enjoy easy access to the vibrant city life of Dubai while still being able to retreat to their own oasis of serenity. Whether it's indulging in gourmet dining experiences, unwinding at the Zen Spa, or engaging in outdoor activities, the locality offers a lifestyle that caters to every desire.

Residents have the opportunity to choose from exquisitely designed residences, each meticulously crafted to blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings while exuding sophistication and charm. From tree-lined views to holistic wellness experiences, every aspect of life is curated to elevate the senses and provide a truly enriching lifestyle.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Tranquil Green Living at Green Vein
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxurious Riverside Townhouses: Discover the tranquility of living in DAMAC Riverside's elegant 4 and 5 BR homes. Perfectly blending serene and sustainable living in Dubai's heart, these homes offer a picturesque lifestyle.
  • Perfectly Positioned in Dubai: Riverside Dubai boasts a prime location between Jebel Ali Al Hibab Road and Emirates Road, ensuring easy access to the city's main attractions and day-to-day services.
  • Stunning Lagoon Lifestyle: Experience life in DAMAC Riverside, where each day feels like a vacation. This community is beautifully designed with water lagoons and lush greenery, perfect for family living.
  • Rich Community Amenities: Life in Riverside offers more than just a home—it's a community. With access to varied amenities for health, wellness, and socializing.
  • Latest Master Development: DAMAC Riverside is DAMAC Properties' newest 4th master development, ideally located near Al Maktoum International Airport, offering luxurious living with high investment potential.

location_tile.title: The Perfect Location in Green Vein Riverside
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the heart of Damac Riverside, Dubai, Green Vein Damac enjoys a prime location surrounded by stunning natural landscapes and urban conveniences. This exceptional neighborhood offers the perfect blend of nature and luxury, with its lush landscapes and breathtaking waterscapes. Located strategically between Jebel Ali Al Hibab Road and Emirates Road, Damac Green Vein provides unmatched accessibility to key locations throughout Dubai, including Expo 2020 and Dubai Investment Park. Explore the tranquil lifestyle and aquatic elegance that only a Riverside Damac neighborhood for sale can offer.

  • 16 Minutes to Expo 2020
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Metro
